criteria.notes: Touch donor wall: letter search, category filter, paged donor grid, amounts formatted from the column type.
Keeps the reference kiosk structure - masthead, category rail, dense two/three-column donor grid - without copying its styling.
Deep green on warm paper with a serif masthead; distinct from the dark dashboard look shared by other examples.
Names carry the grid at every density; the sparse-page height cap stops rows stretching into unreadable spacing.
Light, dark and custom presets all verified; the accent stays legible on both backgrounds.
Donor names and category labels are auto-fitted; long-content and single-field-long scenarios show no clipping.
Verified from 600x600 to 1920x1080 and portrait, including many-categories and uneven-last-page.
One bundled background; icons are inline SVG following currentColor, so nothing degrades by surface size.
Only example that maps arbitrary customer columns to display roles and formats amounts from the TABLE column type.
